subtitle: ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant & Guided Player Answers
changes: Added ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant, a responsive guided-answer studio with a conversational question interface and rotating suggested questions.

Published a curated, versioned knowledge base of 22 documented answers covering companion navigation, Blizzard account connections, talents, gear, progression, addon research, backup, mobile use and privacy.
Assistant offers category filters, clear evidence limitations and direct links to relevant studios; unsupported questions get a transparent fallback, not fabricated information.
Questions are processed locally against published guidance; no generative AI vendor, new Blizzard API calls, local-plan reads, cloud question logging, or account token exposure.
Preserved v7.9.6 combined progression reports, v7.9.5 character handoff, existing Cloudflare Worker, OAuth sessions and saved player data.
Updated player guidance, developer test requests, versioned release history, Gateway label, regression checks and draft Discord announcement; real-player acceptance remains pending.
